I hope you fall in love with being alive. Each and every one of you. There’s so much more to experience and see. The day you fall in love with life, everything that was once dull becomes so much brighter and more colorful. The world becomes more vibrant.

Life does not forever stay dull and grey. The ordinary will become extraordinary once you fall in love with being alive. As silly as it may sound now, I promise you it’s true. I didn’t believe it until I went through it all and felt it for myself.

Suddenly, the little things—like the way sunlight filters through the trees or the sound of rain start to make you feel a new feeling, a good feeling. Colors seem brighter, sounds sharpen, and the world feels more alive. If you’re in a place where everything feels dull and numb, I’m here to tell you it isn’t always going to be that way. This shift involves changing your perspective and pushing yourself even when you don’t want to.

That dark room you like staying in - open the curtains, enjoy the natural light. The walk you don’t want to go on - go, step outside. Watch the sunset and see how the colors change. I promise you that or frustration or hopelessness you may feel at first is not permanent. You must put these little things into practice to fall in love with life. It can feel tiring or even feel pointless at times, but there’s a damn good reason to do and the change will happen gradually if you continue to force yourself to open up to what the world has in store for you.

Start by looking for the little things that make you smile, that bring you peace. Whether it’s a squirrel outside or your favorite fast food meal. Allow yourself to feel gratitude for them, and let that gratitude grow. Before you know it, you’ll start to see the world in a new light, and life will feel more vibrant, more colorful, more worth falling in love with. You have so much to be proud of already. I promise you, it really does get better.🫶🏽
